interpretation_limits: Residuals diagnose inconsistency; they do not by themselves identify a solver or API defect.
Post-step and trapezoidal predictions approximate within-step integration; compare both.
Only COM-derived linear differences may be compared with COM velocity.
Quaternion increments are world rotation vectors; each short step avoids endpoint cancellation.
Joint differences wrap at 2 pi, matching the rotational UR5e/Robotiq coordinates.
Whole-window statistics can mix initial contact and settled contact; inspect a restricted tail if needed.
